selected_evidence.summary: Direct checks before and after restart show the local /etc/passwd entry, UID/GID 1000, Bash shell, and /home/opsadmin owned by opsadmin:opsadmin with mode 700.
The wheel policy grants (ALL) ALL, and password-authenticated sudo returned UID 0 both before and after restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID 296dc102-40b4-430d-a484-11a4151e6c19 was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, and node1 recovered with boot ID a0eae125-2939-41c0-84a1-30ab5fc560b7. The system and sshd were running, and the account, home permissions, wheel membership, password state, and UID 0 elevation all recovered.
